scientific_integrity: An analytic proof establishes all-size results; standalone exhaustive computations verify eight small instances plus tree and biased probability identities. Finite checks do not certify infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Incoming-neighbor synchronous NOR with canonical de Bruijn loops; independent identically distributed Bernoulli initial states; fixed alphabet and fixed bias for asymptotics. Existing minimax-tree work includes the probability fixed-point recursion and rapid off-critical decay. No independent or definitive historical-priority validation.
title: Exact synchronization shells and a critical slowing transition for NOR dynamics on de Bruijn digraphs
